description:
Owner report: stabilization "sometimes stutters", takes long to kick in
on a 58 s clip and on a 4 s clip the video barely starts. Device trace:
every play/pause/drag flipped the preview buffer dims (1280 / 640 /
full-res) and the single-slot plan cache keyed on them rebuilt the plan
each time — 2.3-2.6 s per rebuild, the optical refine re-run for the
same offset every time, all on the render thread.

- Plan cache: 4 round-robin slots (one per recent dims/settings).
- Sync cache: the estimate is cached per clip/log/refine flag/focal,
  never per buffer dims.
- Representative frame times cached (one metadata parse per frame per
  clip).
- Preview paths (render, cached session render, zoom probe, GPU warp
  resolve with asyncRefine=true) start on the lag-prior anchor at once
  and run the optical refine on a detached thread over an independent
  Source (Source::reopenIndependentFd: /proc/se
changed: fix: stabilization starts instantly, no plan rebuild stalls
